rationale: recorder.handle_note_midi_message treated any held grid key as step entry: a held key outside rows 4-7 (a page or menu key) skipped both the held-step branch and the live-record branch, so with record armed the note was not recorded. m_midi still recorded the release's length at the current step, committing a length-only note mask; memory then rebuilt that step's working pattern with trig 0, so at baseline step 1 went silent instead of playing the recorded 72. The held-step branch now requires the held key to be a step; otherwise the armed live-record branch runs as with no key held.
oracle: README 239: with record mode active, notes played on a MIDI keyboard are captured as note masks, including lengths, on the current step of the selected channel. README 316: holding the selected page button is inert (no panic, no page change). Human decision 2026-09-11 for S32: record normally when the held key is not a step.
